duplication_justification: Use pylint symilar's documented default minimum of four significant lines; comments, docstrings, imports and function signatures are declarations rather than implementation duplication. dead_confidence_justification: Vulture defines 100% findings as definite unused arguments/variables and unreachable code. Lower-confidence unused public functions and attributes require caller/dynamic-registration review and are explicitly tracked separately; this gate does not claim full dead-code absence.

complexity.justification: Radon 6.0.1 counts logical lines through the running Python tokenizer. Measured __init__.py MI parameters on identical source: Python 3.11 LLOC90 versus Python3.12 LLOC91, with identical volume120.40465370320703/CC15/comments54.0. Independently measured per-minor baselines avoid false regressions; unsupported versions and new source files fail closed pending explicit measured review. F2/F4 review (2026-10-30): comprehend adds literal items, vendor confinement and provider panels through extracted helpers (max CC improves 22 to 21); its size-sensitive MI baseline reflects the requested expanded input surface. config_schema adds the shared configured plan-cap threshold policy (max CC 2 to 4); plan_admission owns the common hosting/band policy and residency_gate consumes it, removing the agent_spawn_gate surface import cycle. Only these four files were remeasured on both supported interpreters; all other ratchets remain unchanged. Codex session reaper review (2026-10-30): complete changed bodies reviewed in codex_daemon, codex_exec, delegate_jobs and execution_journal. Durable indexed session capture, additive migration, unreaped pruning protection, active/idle owner leases, existing identity-based liveness, bounded transactional delete/retry and terminal gates add required lifecycle safety; journal wrappers and injected dependencies avoid new import cycles. Existing daemon/journal maximum CC stays 49/23; exec rises 17 to 18 for resume lease cleanup; jobs rises 19 to 30 for the explicit terminal/grace/shared-session/live-owner/error gates. Independently remeasured with Radon 6.0.1 under Python 3.11 and 3.12; only these four file baselines changed.
complexity.reviewed_delegate_lifecycle: 2026-10-30: Reviewed complete changed worker, router, job controls, journal adoption and shared warm broker bodies. Increased branches implement PID/birth-verified cancellation, locked identity validation before stale recovery can declare an adopted worker lost, terminal waits, generated CLI controls and race-safe warm cancellation through the existing daemon journal boundary. Worker reuses existing governed completion. Exact Radon 6.0.1 measurements independently recorded under Python 3.11 and 3.12; all other ratchet limits unchanged. Targeting lifetime, cancellation, wait, stream and warm tests include mutation proofs.
complexity.reviewed_delegate_isolation_and_provider: 2026-10-30: Reviewed both complete new modules. delegate_worktrees is standard-library-only git isolation: snapshots tracked dirty and untracked inputs, collects the complete binary delta, retains failures, and cleans accepted workspaces through injected durable metadata/envelope writers. Concurrent actual-router and detached success/cancel tests exercise primary-checkout confinement, cleanup and retained inspection; bypassing isolation makes targeting tests red. subscription_cli_results extracts existing fixed-shape provider decoding and warm fallback contracts with injected transports, preserving errors and usage without package imports or semantic routing decisions. Provider execution targeting tests and read-only-routing mutations cover its consumers. Exact Radon 6.0.1 new-file measurements independently match on Python 3.11 and 3.12; existing file ratchets and cyclic-edge limits are unchanged.
